text: irma: Pushed a tiny change to sparkline axis + tick logic for compact dashboards. Adds a "tick density" mode (Low/Med/High) and a "highlight top percentile" toggle. Quick design + a11y sanity check? cole: Nice. Main worry: reducing ticks can make it hard to read scale at a glance. We should always show active unit (auto/ms/s/K) in the header and a hover tooltip that shows exact numeric ticks. nina: For smoothing: compute anomalies from raw samples always and render sentinels above the smoothed line. Visual rule: show point markers when <=4 anomalies in view, otherwise collapse to a legend badge like "5 extremes". aria: A11y checklist: sparklines need an accessible name (aria-label) and an aria-live summary on focus. Example to include in docs: Sparkline (db-reads): min 2, median 12, max 420. 2 above 95%. aria: Also ensure marker focus announces value + index and legend overflow is reachable via keyboard. Don't rely on color only 94 add a shape/pattern for colorblind mode. cole: Tick formatting nit: prefer SI suffixes with 2 significant figures (1.2K, 3.4ms) and switch to micro/milli suffixes instead of tiny decimals. Add a unit badge: "Units: auto (ms)" in header. nina: Marker design: hollow circle 3px + 2px halo, 24px hit target. For dense cases use a thin vertical bar to avoid overlap. Tooltips should label values as "value (raw)" or "value (smoothed)" when both exist. bot-deploy: PR: added tickDensity flag + rawIndices export. Figma: irma: Acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: unit badge visible, SI formatting with 2 sig figs, default highlight = on (95%), compute extremes from raw, markers <=4 else legend badge, aria-live summary on focus, legend overflow keyboard operable, colorblind pattern for percentile band, perf note to composited marker/annotation layer. cole: tiny copy nit: use "Highlight top percentile (95%)" in quick settings (not "95th"). nina: I'll update the mock for marker overflow states and send a compact example. irma: Thanks all. I'll merge the copy + a11y updates into the PR and ping when ready. :thumbsup:
